text:
alex: Quick handoff — wrapping up my shift. TL;DR: deployments are green, a small perf blip in embed service earlier but recovered. Leaving a short watchlist and action items.

priya: Thanks — noted. Which embed cluster?

alex: priya the eu-embeds cluster (eu1). Memory spiked ~45m ago, OOMs 2x, kube restarted the pod and HPA scaled by 1. Logs show a large batch from partner X.

eli: Was that the partner X backfill? They mentioned a retry storm yesterday.

alex: yep, looks like a retry loop from their side hitting long sequences. I added a temporary rate-limit rule on the ingress to cap batch_size=8 for that client.

oncall-bot: Reminder: nightly maintenance window at 02:00 UTC (2h). Non-disruptive but dedicated nodes will be cordoned for the first 30m.

samira: FYI — if maintenance hits dedicated nodes we might see momentary increased latency on hosted inference. I put a dashboard alert: Hosted p50 p95 traces, alert if p95 > 400ms for 5m.

jake: Quick note: feature flag rollout for consistent-kv-cache-ttl is paused (PR #1623) — waiting on perf test. Do not merge without canary OK.

priya: Action items for night oncall: 1) Watch eu1 embeds memory and watch pod restarts 2) If retry storm persists, add a 1min token-bucket on partner X at the LB 3) Monitor hosted p95 alert and escalate to infra if >400ms 4) Keep the kv-cache-ttl flag blocked until Jake signs off.

eli: I can take the first 60m of the watch. If I see OOMs >3 in 30m I'll scale replicas +1 and open a quick PR for a config bump.

alex: Appreciate it. Notes for oncall: commands I ran: ```kubectl -n embeds describe pod embeds-eu1-7f8b9``` and ```kubectl -n embeds get events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -n 50``` Also checked pod mem profile at /prometheus/targets -> memory:container_bytes; dashboard link: https://dash.redwood.local/d/embeds/eu1-memory

samira: I'll monitor dashboards and have infra on standby. If maintenance starts and latency spikes, flip the routing policy to fallback-region: us-west for 10m to shed pressure.

jake: I'll keep the PR blocked and run the perf job at 00:30UTC. If it passes, I'll ping this thread and add canary.

alex: Thanks all — leaving my phone on but will be offline for sleep after 01:30 UTC. Eli, Samira, loop in infra via pager if anything >sev2. :thumbsup:

eli: Got it, taking first hour.

oncall-bot: Pager oncall rotation: eli is oncall until 03:00 UTC. If paging, mark paging channel #incidents.

samira: small doc update request — adding the ingress rate-limit snippet to the runbook would help. I'll open a tiny PR.

alex: Good call. One more: partner X contact is techops@partnerx.com — they were notified.

jake: pinged in case they push a fix. I'll update PR and reply here.

eli: all set, taking point.

alex: Thank you — handoff complete.
